description:
The /tree overlay should show the count of visible entries vs total entries, e.g., "(2/3)" meaning 2 visible out of 3 total.

**OBSERVED (Elixir):**
- No entry count is shown

**EXPECTED (Node.js):**
At the bottom right of the overlay, show "(2/3)" indicating 2 entries shown out of 3 total entries.

**Where to fix:**
- TreeSelector component needs to track and display entry count
- The count should show filtered/total (e.g., "(2/3)")
- This ticket is blocked by opi-umz.3 (search filtering must work first)
